name: argon-coding-bridge
description: Bridge any local coding agent with Gemini 4 Argon in Gemini Web (Task mode). Works with any Agent Plugins 1.0 compatible coding agent - Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, MiniMax Code and others. Packages codebase context respecting .gitignore, crafts surgical prompts preventing UI distortion, and provides one-click PowerShell patch execution. The Gemini 4 Argon workspace (Task mode + 4 Argon) is configured and verified automatically before a prompt is sent.
